title: Korean Culture & Traditions
description: Holidays, customs, food, and traditional Korean life

items.translation: Chuseok (Korean Thanksgiving / Autumn harvest festival)
Seollal (Korean Lunar New Year)
Hanbok (Traditional Korean clothing)
Tteokguk (Sliced rice cake soup eaten on Seollal)
Songpyeon (Half-moon shaped rice cakes eaten on Chuseok)
Hanok (Traditional Korean house)
Have a wonderful Chuseok holiday.
Happy New Year! (Lit: Please receive a lot of new year blessings.)
On Lunar New Year's Day, we eat rice cake soup (tteokguk).
On Chuseok, we make half-moon rice cakes (songpyeon).
Hanbok is traditional Korean clothing.
Hanok is a traditional Korean house.
Kimjang (kimchi-making culture) is a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage.
Taegeukgi is the national flag of South Korea.
Mugunghwa (Rose of Sharon) is the national flower of Korea.
Gyeongbokgung is the main royal palace of the Joseon Dynasty.

items.target: 남산타워에서 서울 야경을 볼 수 있습니다.
items.translation: You can see the night view of Seoul from Namsan Tower.
Jeju Island is the largest island in Korea.

items.target: 한라산은 제주도에 있는 높고 아름다운 산입니다.
items.translation: Hallasan is a tall and scenic mountain on Jeju Island.

items.target: 한강은 서울 시내를 지나는 아름다운 강입니다.
items.translation: The Han River is a scenic river running through downtown Seoul.
Dongdaemun Design Plaza (DDP) is a landmark of modern architecture.
Hongdae is an iconic street neighborhood of youth and indie art.

items.target: 인사동에서 전통 차를 마실 수 있습니다.
items.translation: You can drink traditional tea in Insadong.

items.target: 북촌한옥마을은 전통 한옥이 잘 보존된 곳입니다.
items.translation: Bukchon Hanok Village is a neighborhood where traditional hanok houses are well preserved.

items.target: 전주한옥마을에서 맛있는 비빔밥을 먹을 수 있습니다.
items.translation: You can eat delicious bibimbap in Jeonju Hanok Village.
Haeundae in Busan is a famous beach.
Bulguksa Temple and Seokguram Grotto are representative cultural heritage sites in Gyeongju.
Pansori is a traditional Korean genre of musical storytelling.
Samulnori is a traditional percussion performance using four Korean instruments.
Talchum is a traditional Korean mask dance drama.
Ssireum is traditional Korean folk wrestling.
Hanji is traditional handmade Korean paper.
Onggi is traditional Korean earthenware pottery.
Makgeolli is a traditional Korean unfiltered rice wine.

items.target: 소주는 한국에서 가장 인기 있는 음료입니다.
items.translation: Soju is the most popular distilled beverage in Korea.
Chimaek is the popular pairing of fried chicken and beer (치킨 + 맥주).
Popular street foods include spicy rice cakes (tteokbokki) and fish cakes (eomuk).
Bungeoppang (fish-shaped red bean pastry) is an iconic winter street snack.
Hotteok is a sweet and chewy filled pancake.
People eat delicious late-night street food at a pojangmacha (tented food stall).
People relax comfortably in a jjimjilbang (Korean bathhouse and sauna).
People sing songs with friends at a noraebang (karaoke room).
People enjoy high-spec PC games at a PC bang.
Food delivery culture is exceptionally well-developed in Korea.
Happy New Year! (Lit: May you receive abundant blessings in the New Year!)
Have a joyful and blessed Chuseok holiday!
Welcome to Korea!
Let's experience Korean culture together.

items.target: 한국은 전통과 현대가 조화를 이루는 곳입니다.
items.translation: Korea is a place where tradition and modernity harmoniously coexist.
Please enjoy experiencing the diverse aspects of Korean culture!
